outcomes.name: real discovery, case, history, filters and validation are deterministic and honest
original case and proposal Markdown bytes are retained from pinned upstream
archived 0.1 semantic golden, unknown fields and inferred provenance survive JSON round trips
portable structural fixtures and frozen schema assertions match the lightweight evaluator
new unknown optional fields are retained without reinterpreting lifecycle or evidence
missing case, bad requests, unsupported operations/versions have stable sanitized errors
malformed JSON, non-UTF8, blank lines and truncated JSONL never yield partial query success
required fields, types, enum values, bounds and array uniqueness are actually checked
every record format version is rejected explicitly; missing versions are structural failures
duplicate case/event IDs and paths, mismatched case IDs and missing event links are not hidden
recorded chronology and exact physical sequence are validated; dates are never invented or sorted
deterministic list ordering and filter semantics do not depend on manifest order
source hash drift, missing anchors and absence are freshness warnings, not falsified historical claims
path traversal, absolute/Windows paths, NUL and escaping symlinks are rejected for records and evidence
internal symlinks work; directories, unavailable roots/files and oversized records fail deterministically
operation references resolve exactly; Forever mappings remain unknown rather than invented
source confirmation is scoped and requires proof; test pointers never imply test success
hypothesis revisions and counterevidence preserve earlier beliefs and latest projection
closure requires recorded automation and browser outcomes; reopening retains closure evidence
invalid hypothesis, outcome and lifecycle payloads cannot masquerade as verified results
immutable API snapshots avoid rescans and refresh only when a new reader is created
CLI adapter emits one JSON envelope, legible summaries and exact error/validation exits
actual CLI entry point works outside the checkout and exits 2 for invalid corpus validation
queries never modify the canonical corpus or cited historical evidence

statementSupported: Only the named local fixtures in tests/debug-api.test.mjs executed with the outcomes retained below; not a provider/browser pass.
